Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick conversation earlier — BlueWave is interested in a more formalized 'Readiness Studio' we can run jointly to certify our SI delivery teams on Redwood deployments. High-level asks from our side:

- A practical cohort that blends instructor-led labs + simulated customer scenarios (we want engineers to emerge able to do a full pilot).
- An assessment/cert that we can map to internal skill levels.
- Tight tie-in to our LMS so we can track completions.

Can you share a draft curriculum (topics/day), an estimate for a 12-person cohort, and examples of outcomes? We're targeting an internal launch in late June. Attaching a short summary of our SI team and typical delivery models (draft-curriculum-v1.pdf).

If helpful, Devon (cc'ed) will provide the list of participants and dates. Would love to set a 30-min kickoff next week to align.

Best,
Kate

Hi Kate — great to hear from you and thanks for the brief.

We can definitely put together a Readiness Studio that matches what you've described. At a high level we recommend two tracks you can combine:

1) Core Pilot Run (3 full days, hands-on):
   - Day 1: Architecture & deployment patterns, private vs dedicated considerations
   - Day 2: Performance tuning, batching, KV caching, and observability hooks
   - Day 3: Failure modes, rollback/rollout playbooks, capstone: run a short end-to-end pilot

2) Enablement Cohort (8 weeks, weekly 2-hr instructor sessions + lab homework):
   - Focus on repeatable delivery processes, checklists, and a final cert sim

Typical outcomes: run a pilot in a sandbox, runbooks for 3 deployment templates, and a certified engineer badge. Pricing and logistics depend on cohort size, whether you want our private control-plane package, and LMS integration effort.

Next steps I propose:
- Quick discovery call (30 min) next Tue/Wed to confirm headcount, target region, and LMS integration scope
- We'll follow with a SOW and a sample schedule + pricing by EOD Mon (7 May)

Soojin will lead the technical curriculum; Marcus will scope pricing and SOW.

Can you confirm preferred times for a call and whether late June launch is firm?

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Partner Programs Manager, Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
